name: Acconeer AB (publ)
summary: Acconeer AB (publ) provides mmWave radar solutions worldwide. It offers A121 radar sensors, which detect distance, speed, motion, and objects; XE125 module evaluation kits, including hardware and software; A111 and A121 radar sensors; XM123 presence and motion modules; and XM125 radar modules. The company also provides XM126 and XM122 radar modules with Bluetooth. Its products are for use in cargo detection, level measurement, presence detection, industry and automation, and automotive applications. Acconeer AB (publ) was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
